resources.string: Per-app preferences below are saved for future protection modes. The Shorts preview has its own switch.
YouTube Shorts preview
The installed YouTube version is supported. Enabling protection makes Unreel press Back when Shorts opens.

Unreel uses Android accessibility access to read the layout of YouTube windows and recognise the Shorts player. When it recognises Shorts, it presses Back. It processes layouts on this device, without reading video titles or messages, storing screen content, or sending it anywhere. You can turn this off here or in Android settings.
